states.definition: No governed learning exposure, practice or assessment record is represented.
Governed exposure exists while later learning milestones remain incomplete.
Governed exposure and practice exist while an integrity-valid assessment result is not represented.
Exposure, practice and an integrity-valid assessment result are represented, but completion review remains due.
Exposure, practice, assessment and review milestones support learning completion without implying Capability.
A material learning milestone or lineage conflict prevents a progress conclusion.
A required learning milestone or lineage meaning cannot be resolved safely.
